title: Google\Cloud\OsConfig\V1\PatchInstanceFilter\GroupLabel
name: GroupLabel
description: Targets a group of VM instances by using their assigned labels. Labels are key-value pairs. A GroupLabel is a combination of labels that is used to target VMs for a patch job.

params.name: data
params.description: Optional. Data for populating the Message object.

params.name: data.labels
params.description: Compute Engine instance labels that must be present for a VM instance to be targeted by this filter.

methods.name: getLabels
methods.description: Compute Engine instance labels that must be present for a VM instance to be targeted by this filter.
